1309-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6794-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6794-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2403-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4875-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4875-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

671-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
671-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

280-2921-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-7730.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

997-2528-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
997-2528-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

1367-7309-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using Don & Leo. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-7309-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

3966-7416.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have Professor Dellian Fel's emblem.
3966-7416.description:
Gain life.
Professor Dellian Fel's emblem triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Archaeomancer and exiling Ephemerate.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
206-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

647-1765-2440-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
647-1765-2440-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

240-997-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

240-647-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more brick counters on it

1805-1978-7170.description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using Living Brain.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

1292-3117-3375-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-4336-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1170-1492-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Welding Jar is in your graveyard.
1170-1492-6643.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1492-6643.description:
Cast Welding Jar from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

3717-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
3717-4067-5672.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2634-5259-5957.notablePrerequisites:
Kianne's power is odd.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2634-5259-5957.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4365-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4365-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

440-1339-2034-3330.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-3330.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2292-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

586-1594-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

277-5226-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
277-5226-5720-5721.description:
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2167-4826-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: You can produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B} between sacrificing lands excluding Port of Karfell to Squandered Resources and/or by tapping those lands for mana.
2167-4826-5531-5732.description:
If desired, activate any number of other mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1} for each land tapped this way.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land other than Port of Karfell, adding {U} or {B} if possible, or any other type of mana otherwise.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other mana-producing lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

2-1496-4017-5296.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Ancestral Statue's toughness.
Workhorse triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Workhorse four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3076-3430-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
3076-3430-4474.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {1}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2397-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
2397-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-2366-2397-2653.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dryad Arbor.
1409-2366-2397-2653.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Nissa twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{U}.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

789-1263-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating an Ooze creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {1}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
789-1263-4050.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

426-2390.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to an opponent.
426-2390.description:
Deal damage to an opponent.
Talon of Pain triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.
